terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Describe observable exterior components in object space and mark inferred hidden routing as approximation.

objectClass.notes: Bottle and botanical counts use one deterministic representative arrangement where generated views vary.

reasoning: The curled roof and centered x=0 doorway establish the macro read.
The sales shelf, bottles, herbs, fungi and still are independent exterior identity systems.
Exact plant species, contents and hidden pipe routing are not claimed.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The compact shell needs explicit layered service systems before two-bucket merge.

detailInventory.scanMethod: four admitted component-zone crops with hero cross-check

definitionOfDone: A floor-seated 7 by 7.2 by 6 yard shell reads as Moonwort Apothecary from all four views and keeps the centered x=0 entrance and service apron clear.

featureGroups.name: Crooked roof and compact hut
qualityCriteria: Curled tips, front dormer and vent remain legible.

featureGroups.name: Potion sales window
qualityCriteria: Awning, shelf and bottles stay attached and exterior.

featureGroups.name: Herbs, fungi and copper still
qualityCriteria: Botanical, glass and copper systems remain readable without loose clutter.

featureGroups.name: Teal, timber, copper, botanical and violet separation
qualityCriteria: The two-bucket merge preserves semantic colors and restrained glow.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not use a straight generic gable.
Keep sales and craft scenery outside a closed shell.

assumptions: The result is a stylized game-ready approximation.
Bottle and herb counts are fixed where generated views vary.
Hidden downspout and still connections use short exterior-only inferred runs.

silhouette.boundingShape: compact offset timber hut under a tall concave teal gable with strong upturned tips
silhouette.symmetry: roof roughly bilateral; storefront, still, herbs and barrels intentionally asymmetric

componentTree.name: Offset timber hut and stone-piling base
componentTree.topologyRationale: A closed set of planar timber wall bays sits on a low stone and piling foundation.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: arched door and three broad steps align exactly at local x=0
dark vertical wall boards are divided by crooked timber posts

componentTree.name: Curled teal roof, dormer and vent
componentTree.topologyRationale: Layered faceted roof bands create the visibly concave ridge and separate kicked end trim.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: stepped roof shells and trim rise at all four corners
small pointed dormer with amber pane grid

componentTree.name: Centered porch and potion sales shelf
componentTree.topologyRationale: The porch, shallow awning and shelf are attached rigid exterior volumes around the closed facade.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: three attached shelves sit below a shallow pale rain awning
steps and standing area remain free of bottles and planters

componentTree.name: Chunky potion bottle display
componentTree.topologyRationale: A bounded row of repeated low-sided bottle bodies and necks is fixed to the shelf.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: five fixed faceted bottle bodies alternate height and violet, teal and amber color
one small octahedral cluster punctuates the bottle row

componentTree.name: Drying herbs and mushroom planters
componentTree.topologyRationale: Herb bundles are repeated tapered stems while mushrooms use bounded stem-and-cap modules.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: fixed three-stem bundles hang from facade and side rails
two attached low pots carry broad faceted violet caps

componentTree.name: Copper still, gutters and rain barrel
componentTree.topologyRationale: The still is a stacked faceted vessel while gutters are short rigid exterior runs grouped as one craft-hardware system.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: bulb, narrow neck and cap form one readable copper still silhouette
short angular dark-metal pipes descend at facade corners

materials.name: Merged Fenbridge opaque vertex-color material
materials.shaderModel: MeshStandardMaterial on Standard/Ultra and semantic vertex-color Lambert-compatible Low path

albedo.samplingNotes: Reference values define semantic families; no studio highlight is copied into albedo.

localOverrides.region: wall boards, shelf and porch members
localOverrides.pattern: axial grain with darker damp lower band
warmer worn convex facets and darker joints

materials.name: Merged Fenbridge warm and violet emissive material

albedo.samplingNotes: Warm windows dominate; violet/teal magic remains a small accent.

localOverrides.region: one crystal/fungus cluster and selected bottle

repetitionSystems.geometry: tapered low-sided stems plus tie band

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: studio-lit concept pixels are material-family evidence, not exact PBR recovery

screenshotReview: Compare front and hero roof curl.
Check centered doorway and open apron.
Check bottle, herb, copper and violet separation on Low and Ultra.

lightingFromPhoto: Neutral upper-left key reveals curled roof courses and copper facets; exposure 1.0 with ACES tone mapping.
Soft frontal fill keeps herbs and bottle silhouettes readable against dark timber.
Neutral environment rim plus floor contact shadow proves foundation seating and shelf depth.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Review only grouped identity systems from the same comparison pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: reference, render, comparison sheet and feature scores

featureReviewTargets.name: Compact shell, curled teal roof, dormer and vent
Accessible x=0 doorway and clear steps
Exterior shelf, awning, bottles and violet crystal
Drying herbs, mushrooms, still and drainage
Teal, timber, copper, botanical, glass and restrained glow separation
Representative bottle and herb counts remain deterministic
Exterior-only model stays within 4,300 triangles and 300 KiB

buildPasses.goal: Lock native bounds and curled silhouette.
acceptance: Compact hut and curled roof match front and hero.

buildPasses.goal: Build centered entry and exterior service hierarchy.
acceptance: Every system stays attached and x=0 approach remains clear.

buildPasses.goal: Add observed bottle, herb, fungi, still and gutter forms.
acceptance: Every inventoried component detail has geometry.

buildPasses.goal: Apply semantic colors and two-bucket response.
acceptance: Low and Ultra preserve service-material separation.

buildPasses.goal: Verify doorway, porch and service apron clearance.
acceptance: No display geometry blocks the x=0 entrance standing point.
At most two primitives, no interior, at most 4,300 triangles and 300 KiB.

actionReadiness.contract: Static exterior hierarchy with stable herbalist and entrance sockets; collision remains runtime-owned.

performanceBudget.texturePolicy: three shared external Fenbridge support maps; no embedded raster texture

proceduralStrategy: Build the closed shell and low foundation from boxes.
Approximate roof curl with bounded faceted bands and kicked trim.
Use deterministic repeated bottles, herbs and mushroom modules.
Merge all geometry into opaque and emissive shipping buckets.
risks: Small bottle and herb counts vary between generated views.
Botanical species and bottle contents are intentionally abstract.
Studio-lit colors inform semantic material families rather than exact PBR maps.
